cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(BloomNanobindIntake LANGUAGES CXX)
set(Python_FIND_STRATEGY LOCATION)
set(Python_FIND_UNVERSIONED_NAMES FIRST)
find_package(Python 3.10 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter Development.Module)
if(Python_SOABI MATCHES "[0-9]t")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Bloom Python v1 requires a GIL-enabled host interpreter")
endif()
set(NB_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(NB_CREATE_INSTALL_RULES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(NB_USE_SUBMODULE_DEPS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${BLOOM_NANOBIND_SOURCE}" upstream EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
nanobind_build_library(bloom-nanobind-static AS_SYSINCLUDE)
install(TARGETS bloom-nanobind-static ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY "${BLOOM_NANOBIND_SOURCE}/include/nanobind" DESTINATION include)
configure_file(nanobind-config.cmake.in nanobind-config.cmake @ONLY)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/nanobind-config.cmake"
    DESTINATION lib/cmake/nanobind)
